title: Custom element
description: An instance of a custom kind the project declares in extensions/kinds/<type>.json (model/custom/<type>/).

type.description: The custom kind of the element: the type key of a file under extensions/kinds/ (MQ1019).

rationale.description: Markdown text: why the element is shaped this way.

decision.description: A URL or a reference (such as ADR-0042) of the decision record. It is not an element id and is not checked.

excludeStereotypes.description: Stereotype keys that a database schema's or a package's defaultStereotypes would give this element, left out with the stereotypes they imply. Only defaults can be excluded (MQ2029).

content.description: The values of the fields the custom kind declares, checked against its properties and required (MQ3033). Free-form for the canonical writer: keys in ordinal order at every level.
